authenticity_review: Multiple AI generation artifacts significantly reduce authenticity. The blue station wagon exhibits severe structural collapse: front grille and headlight assembly are melted with unrecognizable logo geometry (severity 3). Silver sedan shows texture anomalies with blurry hood scoop and distorted emblem (severity 2). Background SUV wheels display perspective distortion with elliptical shapes inconsistent with ground plane (severity 2). Kangaroo feet show fusion artifact with dirt texture lacking contact shadows (severity 1). While overall lighting and composition are coherent, these structural defects are characteristic of generative models rather than photography. The perceptual_quality_auditor reported no graphics-level distortions, but this does not negate the structural artifacts it cannot detect per its NOT_Capable_Of specification.

Blue station wagon front-end structural collapse (melted grille/headlights)
Silver sedan mechanical detail distortion (blurry hood scoop, warped emblem)
